pv38:1.1: Rājā Piṅgalako nāma Suraṭṭhānaṃ adhipati ahu Moriyānaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā Suraṭṭhaṃ punarāgamā. || ||
pv38:2.1: Uṇhe majjhantike kāle rājā vaṅkaṃ upāgami addasa maggaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ petānaṃ vaṇṇanāpathaṃ. || ||
pv38:4.1: ayaṃ maggo ramaṇīyo khemo sovatthiko sivo iminā sārathi yāhi Suraṭṭhānaṃ santike ito. || ||
pv38:5.1: Tena pāyāsi Soraṭṭho senāya caturaṅginiyā ubbiggarūpo puriso Soraṭṭhaṃ etad abravi: || ||
pv38:6.1: Kummaggaṃ paṭipann' amhā bhiṃsanaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ purato dissati maggo pacchato co na dissati. || ||
pv38:7.1: Kummaggaṃ paṭipann' amhā Yamapurisāna santike amānuso vāyati gandho ghoso sūyati dāruṇo. || ||
pv38:8.1: Saṃviggo rājā Soraṭṭho sārathiṃ etad abravi: kummaggaṃ paṭipann' amhā bhiṃsanaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ purato dissati maggo pacchato ca na dissati. || ||
pv38:9.1: Kummaggaṃ paṭipann' amhā Yamapurisāna santike amānuso vāyati gandho ghoso sūyati dāruṇo. || ||
pv38:10.1: Hatthikkhandhañ ca āruyha olokento catuddisaṃ addasa nigrodhaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ pādapaṃ chāyāsampannaṃ. nīlabbhavaṇṇasadisaṃ meghavaṇṇasirīnibhaṃ. || ||
pv38:11.1: Sārathiṃ āmantayī rājā, kiṃ eso dissati brahā nīlabbhavaṇṇasadiso meghavaṇṇasirīnibho. || ||
pv38:12.1: Nigrodho so mahārāja pādapo chāyāsampanno nīlabbhavaṇṇasadiso meghavaṇṇasirīnibho. || ||
pv38:13.1: Tena pāyāsi Soraṭṭho yena so dissati brahā nīlabbhavaṇṇasadiso meghavaṇṇasirīnibho. || ||
pv38:14.1: Hatthikkhandhato oruyha rājā rukkhaṃ upāgami nisīdi rukkhamūlasmiṃ sāmacco saparijjano, pūraṃ pānīyakarakaṃ pūve citte ca ca addasa. || ||
pv38:15.1: Puriso ca devavaṇṇī sabbābharaṇabhūsito upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ Soraṭṭhaṃ etad abravī: || ||
pv38:16.1: Svāgataṃ te mahārāja atho te adurāgataṃ pivatu devo pānīyaṃ pūve khāda arindama. || ||
pv38:17.1: Pivitvā rājā pānīyaṃ sāmacco saparijjano pūve khāditvā pītvā ca Soraṭṭho etad abravī: || ||
pv38:18.1: Devatā nu 'si gandhabbo ādu Sakko purindado ajānantā taṃ pucchāma kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ. || || N' amhi
pv38:19.1: devo na gandhabbo nāpi Sakko purindado peto ahaṃ mahārāja Suraṭṭhā idha-m-āgato. || || Kiṃsīlo
pv38:20.1: kiṃsamācāro Suraṭṭhasmiṃ pure tuvaṃ kena te brahmacariyena ānubhāvo ayaṃ tava. || || Taṃ
pv38:21.1: suṇohi mahārāja arindama raṭṭhavaḍḍhana amaccā pārisajjā ca brāhmaṇo ca purohito. || ||
pv38:22.1: Suraṭṭhasmā ahaṃ deva puriso pāpacetaso micchādiṭṭhi ca dussīlo kadariyo paribhāsako. || ||
pv38:23.1: Dadantānaṃ karontānaṃ vārayissaṃ bahujjanaṃ aññesaṃ dadamānānaṃ antarāyakaro ahaṃ: || ||
pv38:24.1: Vipāko natthi dānassa saṃyamassa kuto phalaṃ natthi ācariyo nāma adantaṃ ko damessati. || ||
pv38:25.1: Samatulyāni bhūtāni kuto jeṭṭhāpacāyiko natthi balaṃ viriyaṃ vā kuto uṭṭhānaporisaṃ. || ||
pv38:26.1: Natthi dānaphalaṃ nāma na visodheti verinaṃ laddheyyaṃ labhate macco niyatipariṇāmajā. || || Natthi
pv38:27.1: mātā pitā bhātā loko natthi ito paraṃ natthi dinnaṃ natthi hutaṃ sunihitam pi na vijjati. || ||
pv38:28.1: Yo pi haneyya purisaṃ parassa chindate siraṃ na koci kiñci hanati sattannaṃ vivaram antare. || ||
pv38:29.1: Acchejjabhejjo jīvo aṭṭhaṃso guḷaparimaṇḍalo yojanānaṃ sataṃ pañca ko jīvaṃ chettum arahati. || ||
pv38:30.1: Yathā suttaguḷe khitte nibbeṭhentaṃ palāyati evam evam pi so jīvo nibbeṭhento palāyati. || ||
pv38:31.1: Yathā gāmato nikkhamma aññaṃ gāmaṃ pavisati evam evam pi so jīvo aññaṃ kāyaṃ pavisati. || ||
pv38:32.1: Yathā gehato nikkhamma aññaṃ gehaṃ pavisati evam evam pi so jīvo aññaṃ bondiṃ pavisati. || ||
pv38:33.1: Cūḷāsīti mahākappuno satasahassāni pi hi ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā saṃsāraṃ khepayitvāna dukkhass' antaṃ karissare. || ||
pv38:34.1: Mitāni sukhadukkhāni doṇehi piṭakehi ca jino sabbaṃ pajānāti sammūḷhā itarā pajā. || ||
pv38:35.1: Evaṃdiṭṭhi pure āsiṃ sammūḷho mohapāruto micchādiṭṭhi ca dussīlo kadariyo paribhāsako. || ||
pv38:36.1: Oraṃ me chahi māsehi kālakiriyā bhavissati, ekantaṃ kaṭukaṃ ghoraṃ nirayaṃ papatiss' ahaṃ. || ||
pv38:37.1: Catukkaṇṇaṃ catudvāraṃ vibhattaṃ bhāgaso mitaṃ ayopākārapariyantaṃ ayasā paṭikujjitaṃ. || ||
pv38:38.1: Tassa ayomayā bhūmi jalitā tejasā yutā, samantā yojanasataṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati sabbadā. || ||
pv38:39.1: Vassāni satasahassāni ghoso sūyati tāvade, lakkho eso mahārāja satabhāgavassakoṭiyo
pv38:40.1: koṭisatasahassāni niraye paccare janā -- || || Micchādiṭṭhī ca dussīlā ye ca ariyūpavādino
pv38:41.1: tatthāhaṃ dīgham addhānaṃ dukkhaṃ vedissa vedanaṃ, phalaṃ pāpassa kammassa tasmā socām' ahaṃ bhusaṃ. || ||
pv38:42.1: Taṃ suṇohi mahārāja arindama raṭṭhavaḍḍhana dhītā mayhaṃ mahārāja Uttarā bhaddam atthu te. || ||
pv38:43.1: Karoti bhaddakaṃ kammaṃ sīles ' uposathe ratā saññatā saṃvibhāgī ca vadaññū vītamaccharā; || ||
pv38:44.1: Akhaṇḍakārī sikkhāya suṇhā parakulesu ca upāsikā Sakyamunino sambuddhassa sirīmato. || ||
pv38:45.1: Bhikkhu ca sīlasampanno gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi okkhittacakkhu satimā guttadvāro susaṃvuto. || ||
pv38:46.1: Sapadānaṃ caramāno agamā taṃ nivesanaṃ tam addasa mahārāja Uttarā bhaddam atthu te. || ||
pv38:47.1: Pūraṃ pānīyassa karakaṃ pūve citte ca sā adā: pitā me kālakato bhante tass' etaṃ upakappatu. || ||
pv38:48.1: Samanantarānuddiṭṭhe vipāko upapajjatha bhuñjāmi kāmakāmī 'haṃ rājā Vessavaṇo yathā. || ||
pv38:49.1: Taṃ suṇohi mahārāja arindama raṭṭhavaḍḍhana sadevakassa lokassa buddho aggo pavuccati, taṃ buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gaccha saputtadāro arindama. || ||
pv38:50.1: Aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena phusanti amataṃ padaṃ taṃ dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gaccha saputtadāro arindama. || ||
pv38:51.1: Cattāro maggapaṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā esa saṅgho ujubhūto paññāsīlasamāhito, taṃ saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gaccha saputtadāro arindama. || ||
pv38:52.1: Pāṇātipātā viramassu khippaṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayassu amajjapo mā ca musā abhāṇi sakena dārena ca hohi tuṭṭho. || || Atthakāmo
pv38:53.1: 'si me yakkha hitakāmo 'si devate karomi tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ tvaṃ si ācariyo mama. || ||
pv38:54.1: Upemi saraṇaṃ buddhaṃ dhammañ cāpi anuttaraṃ saṅghañ ca naradevassa gacchāmi saraṇaṃ ahaṃ. || ||
pv38:55.1: Pāṇātipātā viramāmi khippaṃ loke adinnaṃ parivajjayāmi amajjapo no ca musā bhaṇāmi sakena dārena ca homi tuṭṭho || ||
pv38:56.1: Opuṇāmi mahāvāte nadiyā vā sīghagāmiyā vamāmi pāpakaṃ diṭṭhiṃ buddhānaṃ sāsane rato. || ||
pv38:57.1: Idaṃ vatvāna Soraṭṭho viramitvā pāpadassanā namo bhagavato katvā pāmokkho ratham āruhī ti. || ||
